model_selection: Highest complete fixed blend on latest confirmation day among completed experiments

allocated.budget_source: Both saved development checkpoints select best_fractional_epoch=1.0; fixed before refit
allocated.group_unit: Raw user_id and pt_d, train and final partitions separately
allocated.oversize_policy: Complete oversized group alone; never split, sample, truncate or cap
allocated.loss: Mean row BCE + .01 * mean per-group Poisson(log_input=True,full=False) + 0 * original consistency
allocated.training_targets: Only original train.csv labels / cache label prefix [0,2526320)
allocated.feature_scaler_fit_scope: Original train.csv rows [0,2526320), never final rows
allocated.replay_policy: Fresh model, same backend and identical complete-group batches, every final row; CPU and CUDA strict absolute tolerance 2e-7. CUDA only: if strict comparison fails, a repeated inference on the restored instance must demonstrate nonzero reduction jitter, and all three pairwise errors must be <=3e-7. No CPU/GPU cross-backend comparison or relative tolerance.

id_rule: Zero-based original final row position; preserve nonunique log_id order
